mentions.name: Aescle
mentions.description: Health and productivity app that watches how you live and work, pulling data from health tracking, iOS and macOS screen time, and your calendar to determine what drives your most productive days and make them repeatable. Also surfaces personal patterns such as deeper focus and better sleep.
mentions.problem: Hard to know what drives your most productive days and make them repeatable.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building the health and productivity app I've always wanted - Aescle.

Aescle watches you live and work, pulling data from health, iOS and macOS screentime, your calendar, and more to determine what drives your most productive days and make them repeatable.
